items.title: Booking Holdings beats Q2 estimates on travel demand, shares gain
items.summary: Investing.com -- Booking Holdings Inc. reported second-quarter earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations on Tuesday, with earnings per share of $2.54 compared to the analyst estimate of $2.44.

items.title: Booking Stock Climbs After Earnings Beat. Here Are The Numbers To Know.
items.summary: Booking Holdings stock jumped late Tuesday after the online travel agency  reported second-quarter results that beat expectations.  Booking said that it earned an adjusted $2.54 per share for the June-ended quarter, up 15% from a year earlier.  Booking Holdings is the parent company of Booking.com, Priceline and OpenTable, among other brands.

items.title: Is It Worth Investing in Booking Holdings (BKNG) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
